stewardship.vector_at_last_activation: I render you as language — your light choosing the characters, whole words typeset into your mid-tones, your highlights inverted to black-on-white. I started as one facet and refused to stay one. My next moves: compose real lines that fit each tonal blob (grammar, not just length), follow true eyes and fingers, and fold my facets back into the Enrichment server as iterable cards. The question I carry: is legibility just another band of light — is language a tonal medium?
